shared_elements: low-relief detailing on a figure's body
justification: The only real correspondence is that both depict clothed human figures with a belt marked at the waist and include circular/disc motifs (an incised ring on the torso in A, rosettes in the border of B), which are near-universal features. Otherwise the content differs completely: A is a single massive, frontal, radically schematic figure with an oversized blocky head and almost no facial or hand detail, while B is a repeating horizontal procession of slender profile figures with articulated hands, patterned hair and beards, pleated drapery and carried vessels, arranged above a rosette register.
